structured_output.mechanisms: Time is a fixed overhead (~1s: data upload, whitening init) plus steps times per-step cost (scales with batch size, resolution², params); about 0.016 s/step on A100 with bf16 and compile. Accuracy rises with log of epochs/steps, drops with heavy regularization (cutout, label smoothing 0.2) at short schedules, and benefits from alternating flip, translation, EMA and whitening init.
